peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (33.5): 2.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 127 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Context, not scored: resales in 16.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Novena MRT about 530 m, Toa Payoh MRT about 770 m; closer than 287 of 662 similar developments (the same as 9). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 10 within 2 km; nearest CHIJ Primary (Toa Payoh) about 880 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 180 m), more than 426 of 662 similar developments (the same as 86); nearest hawker centre Whampoa Drive Makan Place/Whampoa Market about 980 m; nearest park Toa Payoh Town Park about 500 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,160 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,160 m; The Orie, 25 new sales, about 1,640 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,820 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 290 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 45 new sales and 755 resales (800 purchases); new sales were 5.6% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 390 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,490 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,680 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,890 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 755 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 322 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 755 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 781 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−3.3%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
